name: @role-orchestrator/budget
description: M4-04 retry classification and resource/cost budgets (A21/A22/A37). The failure-reason vocabulary is a CLOSED strict schema: engine outcome reasons (timeout, nonzero-exit, missing-final-result, ...) map to retry policies - auto (attempt-capped, MAX_NODE_ATTEMPTS=3 total per node), once-then-manual (protocol-error/business-schema-invalid retry exactly once then wait for a human), and manual/recovery (cancelled, approval-denied, credential-locked, process interrupted/observed-running, RECOVERY_REQUIRED result-unknown - NEVER auto re-run, A22). Attempt counting is grounded in the executions table (the A23 slot rows), mirrored into node_retry_state (migration 014) whose CHECKs pin total_attempts <= 3 and conditional_retries_used <= 1 at the CONSTRAINT level. Run budgets (max nodes / max executions / max duration, LimitsPolicy vocabulary) are enrolled per run, consumed inside the scheduler dispatch transaction, and every over-limit dispatch is blocked and held for the user - never auto-continued. Usage follows A37 exactly: a missing usage report is recorded as usage_status='unavailable' with all numerics NULL (never 0 - the CHECK pairing makes a 0-fill structurally impossible), budget checks treat it as UNDETERMINABLE, and crossing the undetermined threshold pauses the run behind a budget_run_holds row that only an explicit human resolution can lift. Requeue-to-WAITING itself lives in @role-orchestrator/scheduler (the queue is its table); this package owns the classification, the state rows, the budgets, the usage records and the holds that guard it.
